title: Validate the owner-authored rulebook before authority
preconditions: The candidate rulebook and expected outcomes are owner-only runtime inputs outside tracked paths; the released classification_v1 Ledger contract, production normalizer, rule evaluator, draft save, and rule validation operations are available.
steps: Run the aggregate-only gate twice over the same private candidate set; account for every row; compare deterministic fingerprints; exercise expected suggestions, explicit no-suggestions, expected conflicts, mixed-purpose rows, sign and account conditions, fee-versus-purchase separation, transfer and linked-refund exclusions from Ledger truth, drift canaries, and owner decision/time measurements; scan every durable and diagnostic output for forbidden payload classes.
expected: Both runs return identical fingerprints and totals; accounted rows equal total rows; incorrect applications are zero; unexplained incompatible conflicts are zero; every drift canary remains explicit; coverage, no-suggestion, conflict, decision, and time totals are present; private descriptions, normalized tokens, financial values, identifiers, rows, and source locators are absent; activation and broad apply remain unavailable until the gate receipt is current.
cleanup: Remove only recognized disposable gate artifacts; retain aggregate receipt and immutable validation fingerprints; leave owner-only source inputs unchanged.
